pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.4: yath' eva mayaṃ sapajāpatikā nāvāya kīḷāma, evam ev' ime samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya nāvāya kīḷantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.8: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā bhikkhunīhi . . . abhirūhissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.14.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā, pācittiyan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:1.15: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ addhānamaggaṃ paṭipannā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.3: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo te bhikkhū etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.5: na bhagini kappati bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhituṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.6: tumhe vā paṭhamaṃ uttaratha mayaṃ vā uttarissāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.9: atha kho tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pacchā uttarantīnaṃ corā acchindiṃsu ca dūsesuṃ ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.10: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave tiriyaṃtaraṇāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:2.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūheyya uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃtaraṇāya, pācittiyan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.10: abhirūhāma bhagini abhirūhām' ayya, abhirūhām' ayya abhirūhāma bhagini, ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā abhirūhāmā 'ti saṃvidahati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.11: bhikkhuniyā abhirūḷhe bhikkhu abhirūhati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.12: bhikkhu abhirūḷhe bhikkhunī abhirūhati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.20: kukkuṭasaṃpāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.1.21: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc28:3.2.1: saṃvidahite saṃvidahitasaññī ekaṃ nāvaṃ abhirūhati uddhaṃgāminiṃ vā adhogāminiṃ vā aññatra tiriyaṃtaraṇāya, āpatti pācittiyassa.
